decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on that still appears on the website, the materials management module is likely kept for another year because an established software firm with some slack will usually give a complementary module more time unless results clearly fall short of aspirations, though its low prominence raises some risk of withdrawal.

The secure healthcare messaging service is presented on its own page and tied to a specific KIM 1.5 update, so it looks close to the firm's core healthcare software offer and therefore is likely to stay on the market unless performance proves distinctly worse than expected.
